replication.target_description: Focal replication explicitly identified by report: new DHS observations after 2005, receipt of antenatal care regressed on HIV prevalence, country-region and year-of-birth fixed effects and maternal/child controls, region-clustered standard errors. Target is the prevalence coefficient in the new-data-only unweighted model.
